Board.description: Name of the board inventory object this device is on. Consumers use it to find the configuration that board exposes for the device, and to associate the resulting sensors with the correct board or chassis. The named board must be present, so it is expected as a FOUND precondition in the platform Probe. Optional; if absent, the device's own configuration object is used.

RootHubPosition.description: The position of the root port on the SOC (0 is first), or the root hub's absolute sysfs platform-device path for controllers not covered by the positional index.

Port.description: The port hierarchy starting at the root hub to which the device is attached.

Configuration.description: The configuration index for the USB device.

Interface.description: The interface number for the USB device.

Name.description: A recognisable name for the USB device
